source.source_truth_rule: Workbook-derived statements below are source-review observations, not automatically canonical Sourceborn truth.

parameter_factorization.formula: 80 DOMAIN CONTAINERS × 25 REUSED INTERROGATION DIMENSIONS = 2000 INSTANTIATED ADDRESSES
parameter_factorization.finding: All 80 containers reuse the same 25 suffix dimensions exactly once.

architecture_matches: Observation Lock and Source Lock align with Point Zero / source sovereignty.
Reverse Chain and Forward Chain align with Universal Sequence reverse-mining and forward reconstruction.
Contradiction Test and Falsifier Test align with R-F-R / epistemic attack.
Memory Write aligns with append-only/versioned memory principles.
Character hypothesis is explicitly a candidate brain-state, not fixed identity.

rfr_findings.name: PARAMETER_COUNT_SEMANTIC_OVERSTATEMENT
rfr_findings.detail: The workbook names 2000 rows as parameters, but the rows are a Cartesian instantiation of 80 domain containers against 25 repeated interrogation dimensions. Several dimensions are evidence, relation, provenance, scope or falsification questions rather than native domain primitives.

rfr_findings.name: PYRAMID_SCORE_RANGE_OFF_BY_TWO
rfr_findings.detail: PYRAMID_INDEX segment-score formulas reference PARAMETER_BANK rows 2:2001 while actual parameter data occupy rows 4:2003. P1999 and P2000 are excluded from S10 scoring.

rfr_findings.name: NO_EVIDENCE_STILL_RANKS_CHARACTERS
rfr_findings.detail: MATCH_ENGINE ranks zero-score candidates 1..100 using row-order tie-breaking; DASHBOARD therefore displays ordered top characters even when all evidence and loop scores are zero.

rfr_findings.name: SCORE_MAGNITUDE_CONFLATED_WITH_CONFIDENCE
rfr_findings.detail: Confidence Band uses ABS(Final Score), so a strong negative mismatch can be labelled Strong/Very strong. Fit direction/magnitude and epistemic confidence require separate fields.

rfr_findings.name: FIVE_LOOPS_SHARE_IDENTICAL_ROUTE_SKELETON
rfr_findings.detail: All five loops reuse exactly the same 10-step reverse path and the same 10-step forward path. Different core questions do not by themselves establish evidential/path independence.

rfr_findings.name: LOOP_RESULTS_NOT_MACHINE_LINKED_TO_MATCH_SCORE
rfr_findings.detail: MATCH_ENGINE loop adjustment columns L1..L5 are manual cells. They are not formula-linked to ARD_5_LOOPS outputs, evidence, contradiction or node completion. The declared no-skip loop contract is therefore not enforced by the score engine.

rfr_findings.name: CHARACTER_WEIGHT_PROVENANCE_OPEN
rfr_findings.detail: The 100 character hypotheses contain normalized segment-weight vectors, but the workbook provides no evidence/provenance fields explaining how those weights were derived. Treat as hypothesis priors/scaffolds, not learned facts.

adoption_guards: Do not add 2000 to the active 3204 Human-derived source count.
Do not treat King-character hypotheses as person identities.
Do not promote workbook scoring constants or weights as canonical without provenance.
Preserve workbook defects as findings rather than silently repairing source truth.
